Definition
[Southern-hemisphere model] \group modelsSource: thurston:page-0020, thurston:page-0021 The inclusion $D^n\subset D^{n+1}$ is a hyperbolic $n$-plane in $H^{n+1}$. Euclidean stereographic projection from the north pole sends it to the southern hemisphere; hyperbolic lines become circles orthogonal to the equator. Intrinsically, the image of $p$ is the endpoint at infinity of the ray perpendicular to the hyperplane at $p$ and directed downward.
